review.imagery: Eleven project renders were visually reviewed. Seven native brochure scenes cover two exterior angles, three living-room concepts/details, bedroom and shared pool deck. Four distinct current-gallery views add day/evening frontages, bathroom and indoor gym. Duplicate pool/bedroom scenes and generic people, spa and cinema photographs are excluded. Published interior concepts remain unit-unspecific. No dated construction photography or card badges.
review.floorPlans: The complete sheets show 12 home layouts and three floorplates across two overview pages. Sizes retain the brochure’s average-area label and printed ranges. Individual units can differ. No private pool is drawn on these home plans. Confirm the contractual area and final configuration with SAMANA. All 14 complete physical pages 28–41 were visually reviewed, including each numerical panel. The twelve values/ranges on pages 30–41 match the selected average-area strings. The key plans preserve floor and unit scope. The first page contains two complete floorplates and remains unedited. No area range is converted into a guaranteed unit total or interior-only area.
review.location: Complete original brochure page 26 was visually reviewed. All fourteen destinations retain their source time groups. The primary page agrees. Its official q value 24.87200140545994, 55.03617900000002 is saved with source hash and six-place conversion. Highways are regional access references. No kilometre distance or direct entrance coordinate is inferred.
review.provenance: Fresh primary HTML and the original developer brochure retain retrieval receipts, original bytes and SHA-256 values. Native image origins, whole-sheet notices and physical-page PDF links remain available. Protected ownership, completed commercial/text research and sold-out/historical-price qualifications are preserved.

unavailable: Contractual unit-specific areas, final fitout, a verified visitor entrance and dated construction photographs were not established. Published average areas retain their original scope.
